name: Triton paper: An intermediate language and compiler for tiled neural network computation
notes:
Original Triton paper by Tillet, Kung, Cox (Harvard). Describes Triton-C (C-like language), Triton-IR (LLVM-based IR), and Triton-JIT compiler. Demonstrates matmul and convolution on par with cuBLAS/cuDNN. The tile-centric approach is the key abstraction.

2026-10-11: Re-read full MAPL 2019 publication PDF (Tillet, Kung, Cox; DOI 10.1145/3315508.3329973). Claims hold: describes Triton-C, Triton-IR, and Triton-JIT with tiled compute abstractions achieving cuBLAS/cuDNN-level matmul/convolution performance on V100/Titan V. Raised 0.5 -> 0.85, status draft -> verified as canonical peer-reviewed publication.
